status: DRAFT — Yehudit will review every card later

cards.title: PORTRAIT SWAP
cards.instructions: Hop on video and draw each other in any style: realistic, cartoony, or totally silly. Not feeling faces? Draw something that IS her, like a favorite snack, a symbol, or a mood. Set a 20-minute timer, then reveal at the same time.

cards.title: SAME TUTORIAL, TWO PAINTINGS
cards.instructions: Pick one short art tutorial (10–20 min) and press play together. Follow along on video, then hold your paintings up to the camera. Same steps, two totally different results. That's the magic.

cards.title: ONE PHOTO, THREE COLORS
cards.instructions: Choose one photo you both love. Each of you picks only 3 paint colors. Paint the same scene and see how your color choices change everything.

cards.title: THE DEMOTIVATIONAL POSTER CONTEST
cards.instructions: Open Canva (free) and make the most gloriously UNmotivating poster you can, like "Tomorrow: also an option." Send both to a third friend to judge without saying whose is whose. The winner gets bragging rights for a week.

cards.title: SAND ART SESSION
cards.instructions: Open a free online sand-art site and pour colorful layers on screen. Share screenshots as you go. No mess, lots of calm.

cards.title: FOLD IT TOGETHER
cards.instructions: Pick a beginner origami tutorial and fold along on video. Any paper works: printer paper, a magazine page, even a receipt. Crumpled first tries are totally allowed.

cards.title: FINGER PAINT PARTY
cards.instructions: No brushes allowed! Use any paint, or mix flour, water, and food coloring. Paint with your fingers on video. Keep paper towels close.

cards.title: TINY GARDEN, BIG CHECK-INS
cards.instructions: Each of you builds a little terrarium on Glass Jar Garden and names your plants. Check on each other's gardens over the next few weeks to see how they're growing.

cards.title: BLIND DRAWING
cards.instructions: One of you describes a picture, but you can't say what it is! The other draws only from the description. Reveal and compare, then swap roles.

cards.title: POSTCARD PAINT & POST
cards.instructions: Paint a postcard for each other on video. A 4×6 piece of cardstock works fine. Write a short note on the back, stamp it, and actually mail it. A surprise in the mailbox a few days later!

cards.title: WORD CHAIN
cards.instructions: Pick a category: foods, places, animals, anything. Each answer starts with the last letter of the one before (Apple → Eggplant → Tomato…). Stuck for 10 seconds? Point to the other side.

cards.title: THE RIDDLE TRAIL
cards.instructions: A secret trail of riddles lives right here on this site! Solve one to unlock the next clue. Work it out together on video. A little prize message waits at the end.

cards.title: CROSSWORD CO-OP
cards.instructions: Find a tough crossword (Saturday puzzles are great) and solve it as a team. One of you shares your screen, and you both call out answers. Pen only if you're feeling brave.

cards.title: FRIDGE MAGNET MADNESS
cards.instructions: Open the Fridge Magnets page on this site and share your room code. You both get the same silly prompt and a pile of word tiles. Tap tiles to build the funniest answer you can, then reveal and read them out loud dramatically. Vote for the winner!

cards.title: STORY PING-PONG
cards.instructions: Take turns writing a story one sentence at a time. No planning allowed. Read the whole thing aloud at the end in your best narrator voice.

cards.title: PICTIONARY NIGHT
cards.instructions: Open skribbl.io and make a PRIVATE room (never public). Turn on "custom words only" and add your own, inside jokes welcome! Draw, guess, giggle.

cards.title: MUG NIGHT
cards.instructions: Two mugs, one cozy night. Mug #1 is a microwave muffin or cupcake (gluten-free: use a GF flour blend or almond flour). Mug #2 is a fancy drink: cocoa with whipped cream, iced coffee, chai. Clink mugs on camera!

cards.title: CHOPPED: SHABBOS EDITION
cards.instructions: Give each other a video tour of your kitchen and pantry. Each of you picks 4 ingredients the other must use in her Shabbos menu this week. After Shabbos, share the results (and any happy accidents).

cards.title: FOOD FUSION
cards.instructions: Open Google Arts & Culture's food experiment, which blends two cuisines into one new recipe. Pick a recipe for each other, or one you'll both make for Shabbos or dinner. Swap in kosher ingredients wherever needed.

cards.title: TREAT-YOURSELF SPREE
cards.instructions: Agree on the same small budget. Each of you shops at the same time, in a store or online, for treats just for you. Meet back on video for a dramatic reveal, one item at a time.

cards.title: SCREEN-SHARE SHOPPING
cards.instructions: Share screens and browse together, like a mall trip from the couch. Hunt for something specific or build dream carts. Buying is optional; opinions are required.

cards.title: PARTY TRICK ACADEMY
cards.instructions: Learn one simple trick together: a coin trick, a card trick, a tongue twister. Practice side by side on video. Then each of you gives a grand performance. Applause required.

cards.title: MANICURE NIGHT
cards.instructions: Gather your polish, files, and a cozy towel. Do your nails together on video while you chat. The drying time is perfect talking time.

cards.title: A–Z MOVIE NIGHT
cards.instructions: Spin the letter wheel on this card! Pick a movie that starts with that letter, then press play at the same time. Popcorn strongly encouraged.

cards.title: CHILDHOOD SHOW-AND-TELL
cards.instructions: Each of you brings one object from childhood: a toy, a photo, a funny old drawing. Tell its story. Then ask each other one question you've never asked before.

cards.title: PLAYLIST SWAP
cards.instructions: Make a playlist for each other with songs that remind you of her. Bonus challenge: make one where the song titles, in order, spell out a secret message.

cards.title: MUSEUM HOPPING
cards.instructions: Pick a museum on Google Arts & Culture and tour it together over screen-share. Each of you chooses a "favorite piece of the day" and says why. Comfy shoes not needed.

cards.title: LETTERS TO NEXT YEAR
cards.instructions: Each of you writes a letter to open in one year (next birthday?). What's happening now? What do you hope for? Seal it, write "Open on ___," and hide it somewhere safe.

cards.title: CURL UP & READ
cards.instructions: Find your coziest spot with a blanket and a warm drink. Put your phone in another room and read for one whole hour. Just you and the story.

cards.title: HOBBY STORE TREASURE HUNT
cards.instructions: Visit a craft store with a small budget. Wander every aisle slowly. Bring home one or two treasures that make you excited to create.

cards.title: A PROPER BATH
cards.instructions: Run a warm bath with a few drops of essential oil (lavender is lovely). Dim the lights, play something calm, and soak. You deserve the slow version tonight.

cards.title: THREE SMALL BEAUTIFUL THINGS
cards.instructions: Leave your phone at home and take a gentle walk. Find 3 small beautiful things: a leaf, a pebble, a pretty shadow. Bring them home and snap a photo for this card.

cards.title: PAINT TODAY IN THREE COLORS
cards.instructions: Pick 3 colors that feel like today. Paint anything: your view, your mood, or just shapes. There's no wrong way to paint a day.

cards.title: A THANK-YOU NOTE
cards.instructions: Think of someone who made your life a little better, recently or long ago. Write them a real thank-you note. Send it or keep it, whatever feels right.

cards.title: THE JOY LIST
cards.instructions: Write down 20 tiny things that bring you joy, like warm socks, the first sip of coffee, a certain song. Small is the whole point. Save it on this card for a rainy day.

cards.title: SUNSET & TEA
cards.instructions: Look up today's sunset time. Brew a cup of tea, find a window or step outside, and watch the sky change.

cards.title: JUDGE A BOOK BY ITS COVER
cards.instructions: Go to the library and pick a book only by its cover. No reading the back! Not your thing once you start? Return it, no guilt. Tell your adventure buddy which cover won.
